title: Frontiers: Machines vs. Humans: The Impact of Artificial Intelligence Chatbot Disclosure on Customer Purchases
authors: Xueming Luo; Siliang Tong; Zheng Fang; Zhe Qu
eligible_reason: Randomized field experiment on chatbot identity disclosure (six arms) with cross-sectional logit/probit/OLS of loan-renewal purchase and call length on treatment arm and customer covariates. No staggered adoption, no DiD.
design_notes: Code.do: logit/probit/reg v3 ib2.v2 + covariates + province dummies; reg/tobit of call length v4; subsamples by answered call and no hang-up.
data_files_note: readme.txt: 'Due to NDA, we provide a 50% randomly generated synthesized sample data'.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary or empty. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
